candidate_ideas.statement: The h^0-stratification of the relative degree-six system for L is equivalent to the h^0-stratification of the degree-4 line bundle M = omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, i.e. a degree-4 Brill-Noether question rather than a degree-6 one, with h^0(L) = 3 (fibrewise |L| = P^2) precisely where h^0(M) = 2, and with h^0(L) = 3 generically.

For balanced g=6, n=6 is the unique borderline puncture number at which the Casnati-Ekedahl failure condition is a single divisor-class (Abel-Jacobi) condition: for n <= 5 the f=5 obstruction has negative degree and the failure locus is empty, while for n >= 7 the obstruction has positive degree and the condition becomes a Brill-Noether condition, so the (6,6) identification does not transport to neighbouring n by the same argument.

The balanced splitting F = O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5) is non-canonical (the Harder-Narasimhan filtration gives a canonical sub O(5) and quotient O(4), so in F^vee the 'O(-5) summand' is canonically only a quotient), yet on geometric fibres the isomorphism class of the relevant summand is O_{P^1}(-5) for every choice of splitting, so W_5, L, and dim H^0 of the obstruction are independent of the chosen splitting.

Descent of a cohomology or weight computation from the ordered model Conf_6 to the unordered reduced-support open is harmless with Q-coefficients because S_6-invariants and S_6-coinvariants agree rationally on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections.

Relative duality in the form O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2) yields the residual identification W_5 = omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), so the failure condition takes the residual shape Gamma in |omega_C(-D)| with D+Gamma canonical.
The residual system has constant relative dimension 2 (a P^2-bundle) over the whole balanced tetragonal moduli, via h^0(omega_C(-D)) = 3 whenever h^0(O_C(D)) = 2; this fails where the pencil jumps.
On fibres where the residual pencil is base-point free, the reduced-support divisors are dense in |L|, so the ordered reduced failure locus is nonempty on those fibres.

established_facts.statement: In the balanced tetragonal setting F = O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5), the bundle W_5 := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C is by convention the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C, and is not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F.

established_facts.statement: At g=6 the degree formula gives deg(W_5|_C) = 4*6+12-4*5 = 16 and deg(W_4|_C) = 4*6+12-4*4 = 20; with deg(omega_C) = 2g-2 = 10 the residual bundle L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} has deg(L) = 16-10 = 6.

established_facts.evidence: Direct substitution into 4f+n-2g-14 with g=6, n=6: f=5 gives 20+6-12-14=0; f=4 gives 16+6-12-14=-4. Cross-checks against deg(omega_C)-deg(W_f)+n = 10-16+6=0 and 10-20+6=-4.
established_facts.statement: At g=6, n=6 and for any effective degree-six divisor Gamma: deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 4*5+6-12-14 = 0 and deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 4*4+6-12-14 = -4.

established_facts.evidence: 2*(2g-2+8) - 4f at g=6 equals 2*18-4f = 36-4f = 4g+12-4f; f=5 gives 16 and f=4 gives 20, matching the substituted values.
established_facts.statement: The degree formula is internally consistent with deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C) = 2g-2+4*2 = 18 at g=6 together with gamma of degree 4, which supplies the -4f contribution from gamma^*O(-f).

established_facts.evidence: deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = -4 < 0 by the substitution above; a nonzero section of a line bundle N gives an effective divisor of degree deg(N) >= 0, contradiction. Combined with the SRC-0004 direct-sum splitting of the obstruction space.
established_facts.statement: On a smooth projective geometrically connected curve, a line bundle of negative degree has no nonzero global section; hence H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 0 for every effective degree-six Gamma on every smooth genus-6 geometric fibre, and the whole Casnati-Ekedahl obstruction at (g,n)=(6,6) is carried by the f=5 summand.

established_facts.evidence: A nonzero section of a degree-0 line bundle N has effective vanishing divisor of degree 0, hence is nowhere vanishing, hence O_C -> N is an isomorphism; the rearrangement omega_C tensor W_5^vee tensor O(Gamma) = O_C <=> O_C(Gamma) = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} is line-bundle algebra. Serre duality is not required for this step.
established_facts.statement: On a smooth projective geometrically connected curve a degree-zero line bundle has a nonzero global section if and only if it is trivial; since deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 0 at (g,n)=(6,6), one gets H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) != 0 iff omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma) is isomorphic to O_C, equivalently iff O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: H^0(omega_C tensor W^vee(Gamma)) = H^0(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) direct-sum H^0(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 0 direct-sum H^0(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)); nonvanishing of the second summand is equivalent to O_C(Gamma) = L. The splitting is used only fibrewise, where F = O(4) direct-sum O(5) does split.
established_facts.statement: Combining the f=4 vanishing, the f=5 degree-zero criterion, and the direct-sum splitting, the geometric evaluation-failure locus Z^{geo} (geometric points where H^0(C, omega_C tensor W^vee(Gamma)) != 0) coincides set-theoretically with the Abel-Jacobi incidence locus of geometric points satisfying O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L.

established_facts.evidence: Riemann-Roch h^0 - h^1 = deg - g + 1 with deg(L)=6, g=6; h^1 >= 0 forces h^0 >= 1.
established_facts.statement: On every smooth genus-6 geometric fibre, Riemann-Roch gives chi(L) = deg(L) - g + 1 = 6-6+1 = 1, hence h^0(L) = 1 + h^1(L) >= 1 and the residual linear system |L| is nonempty; equivalently the unordered residual incidence is fibrewise nonempty in Sym^6.

established_facts.evidence: omega_C tensor L^{-1} = omega_C tensor omega_C tensor W_5^vee; degree 2*10 - 16 = 4. Combined with chi(L)=1 this gives h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)=1+h^0(M). Uses no identification of W_5 with omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D).
established_facts.statement: By Serre duality h^1(L) = h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1}) = h^0(omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee), and deg(omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee) = 2(2g-2) - (4g+12-4f) at g=6, f=5 equals 20-16 = 4; hence h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) with M := omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee a degree-4 line bundle.

established_facts.evidence: Substituting g=6 into 4f+n-2g-14 gives 4f+n-26; f=4 yields n-10 and f=5 yields n-6. Negativity conditions n<10 and n<6 follow directly; equality to 0 at n=6, f=5 matches the substituted value above.
established_facts.statement: At g=6 the obstruction degree as a function of the number of marked points is 4f+n-12-14, i.e. n-10 for f=4 and n-6 for f=5; the f=4 summand therefore vanishes identically for all n <= 9, the f=5 summand has negative degree exactly for n <= 5, and the f=5 obstruction degree is exactly 0 at n=6.

established_facts.evidence: Complement of a closed image is open; a nonempty proper open subset of an irreducible space is not closed. Consistent with the packet instruction 'Model ordered distinct reduced divisors as a finite etale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in the relative linear system; do not call that open locus closed.'
established_facts.statement: The locus of reduced-support (six pairwise-distinct points) degree-six effective divisors in the relative effective-divisor space is open and is not closed: it is the complement of the image of the big diagonal under a finite (hence closed) map, while the non-reduced locus is nonempty (e.g. 6p) inside a fibrewise irreducible Sym^6.

established_facts.evidence: Free finite-group quotients are etale torsors (no ramification, since stabilizers are trivial); residual automorphisms permuting labelled points give nontrivial stabilizers on coarse moduli, breaking freeness there. Matches the packet's S_6-cover model, stated on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections.
established_facts.statement: S_6 acts freely on ordered pairwise-distinct configurations, and a free action of a finite group yields a finite etale torsor in any characteristic; hence Conf_6 -> (reduced-support open) is a finite etale S_6-torsor on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections, with no obstruction from primes dividing 720. Freeness can fail on coarse moduli at curves whose automorphisms permute the marked points.

reusable_computations.statement: Casnati-Ekedahl degree table at g=6 under the gamma^*O(-f) convention: deg(W_f|_C) = 4g+12-4f gives deg(W_5) = 16, deg(W_4) = 20; with deg(omega_C) = 10 this yields deg(L) = deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}) = 6.

The relative-duality identification W_5 = omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D) via O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2), together with the residual description Gamma in |omega_C(-D)| with D+Gamma canonical.

Stratification of the relative degree-six linear system by h^0(L), equivalently by h^0 of the degree-4 bundle omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, and the resulting component, dimension, and stabilizer analysis.
Constancy of the relative dimension 2 (P^2-bundle structure) over all of balanced tetragonal moduli, including the behaviour where the residual pencil jumps.
Treatment of unbalanced Casnati-Ekedahl splittings of F and of the hyperelliptic and trigonal special loci, which lie outside the balanced hypothesis F = O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5).
